description: Make or change a garden on this project's Garden site (garden/): the plants of one real climate, drawn in code as watercolor-and-ink SVG that grows as the page scrolls, by day and by night. Use for a new garden or climate, a plant added, redrawn, or refined, a garden's composition changed (sides look empty, plants crowd, the sky fills up), seasons or water given to a garden, or a plant's look researched, even if the user never says "skill" or names the files.
